openai.scope: OpenAI API public list prices; cloud/gateway invoice equivalence not asserted

anthropic.scope: Claude API public list prices; partner platform equivalence not asserted

anthropic_policy: Resolve exact observed model and applicable context, caching, service tier and geography against the approved source before adding rates. Do not fabricate usage or map unknown aliases by similarity.

example.method: Public standard short-context rates applied to all observed prompt and completion tokens
assumptions: All prompt tokens treated as uncached regular input; cache reads and writes are not measured by this aggregate
Standard service tier and no regional uplift assumed
Current observed price snapshot applied retrospectively; historical tariff effectiveness not proven
excluded: Gateway markup, negotiated discounts and taxes
Embedding, audio and tool charges not reported in this usage response
example.billing_status: Not a billed amount or complete total; not a guaranteed upper bound
